attribution: nflverse contributors, CC-BY-4.0 (players, rosters, stats, snap counts, combine); cited news pages
selection_rule: Every player with a regular-season NFL game (2012+ stats or snap counts), not on a 2026 roster or reserve list (nflverse roster_2026, fetched 2026-10-22; a CUT status counts as released), not retired in nflverse, on a roster in 2024 or later and at most 34 (QB, K, P 40), Colin Kaepernick by name. Ranked by what he adds over the disc's third-best free agent at his position; each kept player checked by hand for a 2025-26 retirement or signing (news search, 2026-10-22). Retired and skipped: Bozeman, Morse, Dalman, D. Andrews, Seibert, R. Kelly, Clapp, R. Wilson, Scherff, L. Wilson, J. Simmons, D. Williams, N. Chubb, S. Hubbard, B. Huff; under contract: B. Aiyuk.
rating_policy: nfl2k5_ratings_model (m2-ratings-3) per played season, last three played seasons blended by recency (2026/2025 1.0, 2024 0.6, 2023 0.3) x snaps/400 (0.15..1); then -1 speed/agility per year past 30 since the rated season, -2 speed/agility/stamina per full season out of the league (cap 12) and -1 per season on every skill (cap 8).
appearance_policy: Official NFL headshot reviewed by eye for skin tone 0..5 and locs; the dated free agents' neutral native face (tone 0 variant 5, other tones variant 0); no portrait (photo 20000 + record index, as the dated free agents).
commentary_policy: Verified generic surname clip when one exists, else the jersey number (never another player's full name).
